240-1251-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-1251-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

512-527-4644.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-527-4644.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-527-4644.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

413-1703-4984.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it and Blasting Station trigger
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Academy Researchers trigger, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

4871-5220-6798-7855--180.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, Pitiless Plunderer, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat

2976-5702-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2976-5702-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Animate Land
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3504-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3504-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3504-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1394-2060-2438-7038-7741.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Shang-Chi.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Shang-Chi.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3088-7685.description:
Animate Arc Reactor using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-6553-7424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

891-3967-7424.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

5058-6797-7396.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1806-1887-2060-6797-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vorinclex.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

3991-4050-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3991-4050-4605-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

1069-2034-3169-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-2034-3169-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {2}.
When the creature enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

5070-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
5070-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4476-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-4476-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

147-780-3967.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

1414-2438-2866-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3678-5235-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-5235-6879.description:
Play Brokers Hideout.
When Brokers Hideout enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Brokers Hideout.
Resolve the Brokers Hideout trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it, search your library for an applicable land and put it onto the battlefield tapped, and gain 1 life.
Haru triggers, returning Brokers Hideout from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4772-4968-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Doubling Season.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
4772-4968-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

3963-5261-6587-6588.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

2105-3719-3967-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven creatures, excluding Combat Celebrant, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Combat Celebrant or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2105-3719-3967-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping seven creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

64-372-695.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-695.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

864-1719-2628-6185.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
864-1719-2628-6185.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands' cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it due to New Perspectives.
Escape Protocol and Vizier of Tumbling Sands trigger.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbing Sands trigger, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Reoslve the Escape Protocol trigger, blinking Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vizier of Tumbing Sands from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

413-1238-2351-5467-5929.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability
Repeat.

2047-2793-5261-5995.easyPrerequisites: Mechanized Production attached to Ugin's Nexus.
2047-2793-5261-5995.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the Ugin's Nexus token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vision Charm without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Vision Charm, causing Ugin's Nexus to phase out until your next untap step.
Move to your next turn, causing Ugin's Nexus to phase in during your untap step.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3327-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-3327-3967.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

1267-3874-5406.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Armory Automaton does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Medomai the Ageless exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
1267-3874-5406.description:
Declare Armory Automaton as an attacker.
Armory Automaton triggers, causing you to attach Dinosaur Headdress to it, and causing Armory Automaton to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Armory Automaton.
Armory Automaton triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
Repeat each turn.

1636-2744-3000-4170.notablePrerequisites: Fain does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2744-3000-4170.description:
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a counter from a creature you control, creating a Treasure artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure and Squirrel tokens, you may activate Fain's other abilities.

1314-1806-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Brenard triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Eternal Scourge tokens.

765-1462-2929.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1358-1978-2585.description:
Animate Grim Monolith using Sydri.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Grim Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.
